gizmo.title: Chaatị radar
gizmo.description: Chaatị radar (ududo) maka ụdị ntozu na akara akụkụ, dịka HEOSAT. Gụnyere ederede nnọchi na tebụl data.

configure.title: Aha
configure.description: Isiokwu maka chaatị ahụ; a na-ejikwa ya dịka aha enwere ike ịnweta.

configure.description: Ọnụọgụ kewara site na rịkọm, otu maka ngalaba ọ bụla n'otu usoro ahụ.
